goal: Clean up the IPC child-process bootstrap code: replace the bool-plus-out-param checkSpawned() with std::optional, rename the confusing -ipcfd flag to -ipcchild since it's a pipe path on Windows, and add unit test coverage for the parsing logic.
reviewability: Ready to review, code is small and settled after two review rounds.
agreement: Strong support with two contributor ACKs after testing (jeanpablojp, enirox001)
No objections raised, one nit was addressed by adding a missing test case

result.summary: This PR implements follow-up cleanups requested during review of #35084: it changes ipc::Process::checkSpawned() to return std::optional<mp::SocketId> instead of a bool plus output parameter, renames the -ipcfd command-line argument to -ipcchild (since on Windows it's actually a named pipe path, not a file descriptor), and adds unit tests covering the various checkSpawned() argument-parsing cases. The changes are mechanical and small, touching bitcoin.cpp, ipc/interfaces.cpp, ipc/process.cpp/.h, the ipc test file, and a lint script's arg allowlist.
result.problem: The prior checkSpawned() API used an unclear bool+output-parameter pattern predating C++17 optional, the -ipcfd flag name was misleading since it carries a pipe path on Windows, and the parsing logic lacked unit test coverage, all noted as desirable follow-ups by ryanofsky during #35084 review.

result.card: This PR implements follow-up cleanups explicitly requested by ryanofsky during review of #35084: it changes ipc::Process::checkSpawned() to return std::optional<mp::SocketId> instead of a bool with an output parameter, renames the confusing -ipcfd argument to -ipcchild (since on Windows it carries a pipe path, not a file descriptor), and adds unit tests for the argument-parsing logic. The change is small (+67/-24), self-contained, and CI is clean. Two contributor reviewers (jeanpablojp, enirox001) tested and ACKed the final commit after the author addressed a missing test-case nit via force-push, leaving no open objections. It is a maintenance and clarity improvement to the IPC spawn bootstrap with no external consumer blocked on it, so it is worthwhile but not urgent.
